Privacy & Safety

Your voice.
Handled with care.

Feedback, account details and enquiries have different privacy needs. This notice explains those differences and the limits of anonymous participation.

Draft for legal review · Updated 29 October 2026 · Privacy contact: hello@catalystbox.in

Who this notice covers

CatalystBox is an education intelligence and improvement platform. Draft operator identification: CatalystBox OPC Private Limited. [TODO: confirm with founder] Verify the exact registered legal name and contracting entity before adopting this draft. Contact hello@catalystbox.in for the contracting entity and registration documents applicable to a proposed engagement. This notice makes no claim of charitable status, tax exemption or independent certification.

This notice covers this website and its enquiry and linked feedback forms. Reportcard and Marketplace have their own notices and account requirements; review those on the relevant service before participating.

Feedback and anonymity

Feedback is intended for aggregate reporting. A form may collect institution, respondent category, ratings, optional written answers and submission time. Read its notice and fields before submitting. Account or verification requirements can differ between services and deployments.

Do not include names, contact details, roll numbers or details that could identify you or another person in written answers. Free text, small groups and contextual details can make a response identifiable even without a name. We cannot promise that re-identification is impossible.

Institutional reports should contain aggregate results with publication safeguards. Authorised processing of responses to operate a service is different from publishing individual answers. These forms are not an emergency or safeguarding reporting channel.

Accounts, enquiries and third parties

If you contact us, apply for a partnership or use an account, you may provide your name, email, phone number, institution and message. We use these details to respond, manage the requested service and protect access. Do not send sensitive student information through an enquiry form.

This site links to or embeds Google Forms and uses FormSubmit to deliver some enquiries. Those providers process submitted information under their own terms and privacy notices. Hosting, authentication and other service providers may process technical information such as IP addresses, cookies, session information and security logs. We cannot promise that infrastructure providers keep no logs.

This marketing website includes Google Analytics and Google Ads tags. These can process browser, device and interaction information and use cookies or similar storage. [TODO: confirm with founder] Confirm the active tag settings, consent controls, recipients and retention before adopting this draft. Site preferences may be saved in browser storage. External forms and linked services can have different cookie and storage practices.

Children and institutional deployments

Participation should be voluntary and age-appropriate. Before deploying feedback with children, the institution and CatalystBox must establish the applicable notices, permissions, parental or guardian consent where required, and safeguarding responsibilities. Removing name fields alone does not remove legal obligations.

A feedback service cannot replace a school's safeguarding procedures or professional support. Raise urgent concerns through the institution's designated channels.

Use, access and retention

Feedback supports institutional analysis and reporting; enquiry information supports the request you make. We do not use student feedback for advertising or individual targeting. Research access is limited to appropriately aggregated information under agreed safeguards. We do not sell identifiable student feedback.

Access, storage location and retention depend on the service, data category and deployment agreement. [TODO: confirm with founder] Document the hosting regions, processor list, retention periods and deletion process for feedback, enquiries, accounts and technical logs. Contact us for the applicable schedule, processing providers and any deletion request. We do not promise a universal account expiry or automatic deletion interval that applies to every connected service.

We use access controls and secure transport to protect information. No service can guarantee that a breach or unintended personal disclosure is impossible. Security incidents require assessment and notification in accordance with applicable law and service obligations.

Your choices and privacy requests

You can choose not to submit a form. To request access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent or help with a privacy concern, write to hello@catalystbox.in. If a response cannot be linked to you, we may be unable to locate it safely. Please do not send more identifying information than needed to explain your request.

Applicable rights and requirements depend on the service, jurisdiction and commencement of relevant law. This notice is not a certification of compliance. The intended approach is alignment with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and applicable notified Rules, subject to their commencement and legal review; this draft does not assert completed compliance. India's DPDP framework includes the Act and notified Rules; consult the official framework for current provisions.

Material changes that reduce privacy protections or alter data use require at least 30 days' public notice. This update corrects descriptions and distinguishes services; it does not authorise new data collection or disclosure.
